ov: A blind, pale salamander that lives its whole life underwater in the flooded limestone caves of the Dinaric Alps, the only cave-only vertebrate genus in Europe. Long treated as one species, it was split into nine in 2026. It finds its way by smell, hearing and even magnetic fields.
rg: Underground waters of Slovenia, southwestern Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina and northeastern Italy.
df: Small crustaceans, snails and occasionally insects.
fx: Local people once believed olms washed out of caves by heavy rain were the young of a cave dragon.
Adults live about 68.5 years on average, and the maximum lifespan is estimated at over 100.
notes: RESOLVED (owner approved all suggestions, including the optional ones, 2026-09-29): The fact is confirmed: "an olm can survive up to 10 years without food".
